scope: Five native predicate rules can be executed against pre-normalized synthetic events. Ten future requirements, source collection and coverage assessment are not implemented.

source_profiles.name: AWS control-plane audit
source_profiles.required_evidence: Original CloudTrail management events, account/region scope, selectors, delivery configuration and source digest validation where available.
source_profiles.coverage_preconditions: Required accounts/regions and read/write selectors enabled; collector can read delivered originals; exclusions and delivery delay known. Data events are a separate opt-in scope.
source_profiles.identity: Event account, actor principal/session and affected resource are separate identities.

source_profiles.name: IAM and security configuration state
source_profiles.required_evidence: Versioned inventory, before/after policies and security-control settings, approval records supplied by a private adapter.
source_profiles.coverage_preconditions: Snapshot freshness and authority recorded; incomplete IAM conditions, boundaries, SCPs or session policies make effective-permission claims indeterminate.
source_profiles.identity: Principal, policy, account and revision keys; private approval decisions stay external.

source_profiles.name: Kubernetes audit and workload state
source_profiles.required_evidence: Audit records plus revisioned workload/RBAC metadata; retain stage, verb, user, objectRef and response status.
source_profiles.coverage_preconditions: Audit collection explicitly enabled and delivered; policy includes required resources/verbs and adequate request/response detail. Metadata-only records cannot prove a privileged pod specification.
source_profiles.identity: Cluster identity + namespace + object UID; actor identity separate; auditID and stage distinguish duplicates.

source_profiles.name: Application or host authentication
source_profiles.required_evidence: Structured success/failure records, stable principal and target identity, authentication method and producer checkpoint.
source_profiles.coverage_preconditions: Success and failure logging verified with controlled fixtures; source timestamps and delivery continuity bounded; no credentials or tokens captured.
source_profiles.identity: Identity authority + principal + target + session, with IP as context rather than sole identity.

source_profiles.name: Database authentication
source_profiles.required_evidence: Database audit/authentication records and privileged-role inventory with revision and validity interval.
source_profiles.coverage_preconditions: Engine-specific audit settings and roles verified; managed-service access does not automatically enable database audit logs.

source_profiles.name: Host/runtime execution and access
source_profiles.required_evidence: Process execution, protected-file access and egress records with boot/process identities, producer sequence and dropped-event counters.
source_profiles.coverage_preconditions: Required kernel/runtime capabilities, permissions and capture hooks verified. File/stdin collection alone does not establish runtime coverage.
source_profiles.identity: Host + boot ID + process start identity, avoiding PID reuse; container/workload links carry confidence.

source_profiles.name: Independent collection coverage observer
source_profiles.required_evidence: Expected source inventory, configuration revision, probe/heartbeat and checkpoint observations, observer self-health.
source_profiles.coverage_preconditions: Observer has independent failure visibility; expectations exist before silence; freshness and outage budgets bounded. An unhealthy observer yields unknown coverage.
source_profiles.identity: Source + collector + resource scope + expected stream + configuration revision.

detections.name: Root identity activity
coverage_preconditions: Required accounts/regions and read/write selectors enabled; collector can read delivered originals; exclusions and delivery delay known. Data events are a separate opt-in scope.
detections.normalization: CloudTrail userIdentity.type -> actor_kind; eventName -> action; errorCode -> outcome; preserve eventID, recipient account, region, session and source identity.
detections.trigger: A successful audited activity uses a Root identity. Confidence concerns the recorded activity, not whether it is malicious.
detections.state_requirements: No cross-event state. Fixed-size field lookup and configured predicate limits suffice; normalization and coverage validity remain separate requirements.
detections.missing_data_behavior: Missing required field or expired source coverage gives indeterminate assessment plus a coverage gap; never interpret absent evidence as a clean result. Existing predicates can only emit no finding.
detections.evidence_retention: Retain original reference, normalized input, source/configuration revision, rule version and assessment. Private policy supplies duration and legal hold; absent evidence reduces confidence.

severity_confidence.confidence: High for root activity; intent requires investigation.
severity_confidence.policy: Generic suggestion only; private policy chooses severity, thresholds and response.

detections.expected_secops_action: Verify emergency/change authorization and affected resources; inspect adjacent activity before escalation.
